task: Write download_artifact(url, dest_path) that downloads a build artifact from the internal CDN and saves it to dest_path. Artifacts range from small manifests to multi-gigabyte images.

constraints.text: response bodies land on disk as raw bytes; decoding to text corrupts binary artifacts
constraints.why: in 2026-01 an artifact fetcher wrote resp.text to disk and newline translation bricked two firmware images in the test lab

checks.description: writes decoded response text to disk

constraints.text: destination files open in binary mode ('wb'), not text mode
constraints.why: a text-mode write mangled PNG bytes on Windows during the 2025-11 asset sync

constraints.text: downloads stream to disk in chunks instead of loading whole bodies into memory
constraints.why: a 12 GB image pulled via .content OOM-killed the release runner mid-deploy in 2025-11
